raw_comment:
1) I noticed that for the most part, the most severe and constant cases of drought happen in the very center of the US. with very little drought on the western and eastern seaboard. I also noticed that Texas is experiencing quite a bit of drought along its borders but not within the heart of the state.
2) I wonder why Texas is experiencing drought along its borders but not in the center of Texas. I also wonder why most of the droughts are right in the middle of the US. 
3) This relates to me and my community because it shows that Michigan especially northern Michigan is experiencing severe droughts, this affects my community because that impacts the farming economy of Michigan. Less crops can be produced with very little rain to help them grow.
4) "Heartland in a heat grip: Drought tightens on the center states of the US"
